text:
Priya Nair: quick check — planning to flip the kernel transmission patch on the canary pool at 09:30 PT. need owners, rollback plan, and the exact metrics we'll watch. short checklist?
Liam Chen: i'm owning the kernel change. CR is up: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/742. patch reduces kv prefetch window and changes batch coalescing. i'll be online at 09:15.
Marco Diaz: staging run results are in — kv_hit_ratio jumped 5% under the load profile, but p95 latency moved +12ms. pushing a second run with a smaller batch window. will paste numbers in a sec.
Anya Petrov: oncall here. if things go south we can rollback using the canary tag. rollback command: `./scripts/rollback_canary.sh canary-rc` and i can trigger infra-level fallback. i'll watch alerts. :eyes: 
Liam Chen: notes on what to watch: perf_p95, kv_miss_rate, average_tokens_per_request, queue_length. if kv_miss_rate > 2% for 2m -> immediate rollback.
Priya Nair: good. Marco — can you share exact numbers and the query you used? Ops wants reproducible checks.
Marco Diaz: posted results (short): p50 21ms -> 19ms, p95 58ms -> 70ms, kv_hit_ratio 0.87 -> 0.92, kv_miss_rate 0.013 -> 0.018. query i used: ```
curl -s 'https://console.redwood.internal/api/v1/metrics?query=kv_hit_ratio&range=5m' | jq .
```
runtime-oncall: deploy-bot scheduled canary rollout at 2026-03-18T16:30:00Z for pool runtime-canary-3. health checks: 30s interval, 5m grace.
deploy-bot: Canary job created: job/rollout/runtime-canary-3. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/742 :rocket:
Priya Nair: thanks. two clarifications: (1) does the kernel change require any client-side config changes? (2) are there correlated alerts we should mute for noisy churn?
Liam Chen: (1) no client changes. server-side only. (2) i'll mute the kv_miss_rate alert for 10m across the canary pool so we don't spam. will add a temporary threshold for p95 alert to 120ms.
Anya Petrov: i'll be on pager for the window and handle immediate rollbacks. i'll also have the rollback script ready in the canary runbook.
Marco Diaz: starting the final verification run now. command i ran to tail logs: ```
kail -l app=runtime-canary-3 | grep -i "kv_miss" --line-buffered
```
Priya Nair: ok — if no objections i'll give the go at 09:25 PT. please react with :thumbsup: when you're ready.
Liam Chen: :thumbsup:
Marco Diaz: :thumbsup: verifying metrics now.
Anya Petrov: :thumbsup: oncall ready.
Priya Nair: rolling at 09:30 PT. i'll post a tiny status thread once it's live. thanks everyone for quick turn.
Marco Diaz: posting a short followup with numbers after 5m into canary.
Liam Chen: if we see p95 > 120ms or kv_miss_rate > 2% for two consecutive windows, i'll initiate rollback.
runtime-oncall: monitoring configured. alerts routed to #eng-oncall and priority escalation to Anya.
Priya Nair: end status: go-ahead given. will update with final numbers.
Marco Diaz: final (5m) snapshot after flip: p50 20ms, p95 68ms, kv_hit_ratio 0.915, kv_miss_rate 0.017 — within agreed tolerances. leaving canary open for another 45m.
Priya Nair: excellent. closing this check-in — move any followups to the PR comments. :tada:
